sentences.text: 该词源自盎格鲁-诺曼语中指精炼金属的熔炼所，更早源自法语bouillon（沸腾）。
sentences.evidence: It comes from the Anglo-Norman term for a melting-house where metal was refined, and earlier from French bouillon, "boiling".

sentences.text: 在欧盟，金条纯度至少99.5%、金币至少90%方可称为“bullion”，在税收上按投资黄金对待。
sentences.evidence: the minimum purity for gold to be referred to as "bullion", which is treated as investment gold with regard to taxation, is 99.5% for gold bullion bars and 90% for bullion coins

sentences.text: 伦敦金银市场协会规定合格交割金条最低成色为99.5%，银条为99.9%。
sentences.evidence: The minimum acceptable fineness of the Good Delivery Bars is 99.5% for gold bars and 99.9% for silver bars.
